intro: Music: instruments, concerts and the people who make them possible.
p.letra.consejo: It is also each sign of the alphabet. In a song you say «la letra» and you sing it.
p.cantante.consejo: It works for a man and a woman: «el cantante», «la cantante». It comes from «cantar».
p.grupo.consejo: It is also any set of people or things. A music group is also called «banda».
p.en directo.consejo: In Spain you say «en directo»; in other countries, «en vivo». A live concert is heard at that moment.
p.gira.consejo: You say «estar de gira». The g sounds like h: HI-ra.
p.disco.consejo: A band «saca» a disco when it releases it. Today it can also be heard online.
p.ensayar.consejo: Its noun is «ensayo». The y sounds like in «yo»: en-sa-YAR.
p.ritmo.consejo: It starts with a strong rr: RRIT-mo. You say «llevar el ritmo» with your hands or feet.
p.voz.consejo: The plural is «voces»: the z changes to c. You say «tener buena voz».
p.éxito.consejo: False friend: it means «success», not «exit». It has an accent: EK-si-to.
p.violín.consejo: The v sounds like b: byo-LIN. The accent shows the stress is at the end.
p.batería.consejo: The person who plays it is also called «batería». The «batería» of a phone is something else.
p.componer.consejo: It is conjugated like «poner»: yo compongo, tú compones. The «compositor» composes songs.
p.emocionar.consejo: It works like «gustar»: «me emociona esa canción». The thing is the subject and you are the «me».
b1.texto:
People: **el cantante**, **el compositor**, **el músico**, **el guitarrista**, **el pianista**, **el director de orquesta**, **el bailarín**. Words in **-ista** are the same for men and women: **el / la** guitarrista.

You **tocar** an instrument (la guitarra, el piano, el violín, **la batería**). You **cantar**, **bailar**, **componer** and **ensayar**.

A band **saca** an album, **da** a concert and **está de gira**. Music played during the concert is **en directo** (or **en vivo**).

A song has **letra** and **música**. If many people like it, it is **un éxito**.

To say what music does to you, use the pattern of **gustar**: **me emociona**, **me relaja**, **me pone** in a good mood, **me recuerda a** my childhood.

**Tener buen oído** is to notice sounds well. **Saberse** a song **de memoria** is knowing all of it.
b2.f0.texto: My brother has played drums in a band for ten years.
b2.f2.texto: They rehearse three times a week in a garage.
b2.f4.texto: He writes almost all the lyrics.
b2.f7.texto: Last year they released their first album, which was an unexpected hit.
b2.f8.texto: And what are they doing now?
b2.f9.texto: Now they are on tour and give two live concerts every week.
b4.texto:
Three resources to talk about music:

- **Desde hace** + time, with the present: something that began in the past and goes on now. **Toca la batería desde hace diez años.**
- **Tocar** an instrument, **cantar** a song, **componer** music and **ensayar** before the concert.
- Verbs like **gustar**: the thing is the subject and you go with **me / te / le**. **Esa canción me emociona. Esa canción me recuerda a mi infancia.**
b4.e0.texto: My sister has played the violin for three years.
b4.e1.texto: This song moves me a lot.
b4.e2.texto: That song reminds me of my childhood.
b5.f0.texto: In the garage it smells of old paint and warm cables.
b5.f1.texto: A yellow spotlight lights up the drums and the microphones.
b5.f2.texto: Two guitars hang from the wall with their strings taut.
b5.f3.texto: Marta's brother softly hits the cymbals.
b5.f4.texto: The singer closes her eyes and waits for the first note.
b5.f5.texto: Suddenly the voice rises to the ceiling with a clear shine.
b5.f6.texto: The rhythm of the drums beats like an enormous heart.
b5.f7.texto: The violin comes in afterwards with a sad and sweet melody.
b5.f8.texto: Marta closes her eyes and feels the music in her chest.
b5.f9.texto: When the last song ends, the garage falls silent for a few seconds.
b6.frase: Mi hermana ____ el violín desde hace tres años.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! The verb for instruments is «tocar».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Jugar» is for sports and games, not for instruments.
b6.pregunta: Which verb goes with an instrument?
b7.o0.refuerzo: The rhythm is the order of the beats, not the words.
b7.o1.refuerzo: The «gira» is a trip of concerts.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That is it! The «letra» is the words that are sung.
b7.pregunta: What are the words of a song called?
b8.frase: Dan dos conciertos en directo cada semana
b8.traduccion: They give two live concerts every week
b9.o0.refuerzo: Rehearsing is practising, usually in one place.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Yes! A «gira» is a trip with concerts in several places.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Writing lyrics can be done at home; it is not what «gira» means.
b9.pregunta: A band is on tour. What does it do?
b10.frase: Esta canción me ____ a mi infancia.
b10.o0.refuerzo: Well done! The song is the subject: it reminds me.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Recuerdo» would be «yo», but the subject is the song.
b10.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive does not work: a conjugated verb is needed.
b12.o0.refuerzo: That is it! You rehearse so everything goes well at the concert.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Tickets are sold at the box office; they are not rehearsed.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Writing or composing is different: «ensayar» is practising.
b13.frase: Su primer ____ fue un éxito inesperado.
b13.o0.refuerzo: Rhythm is part of the music, but it is not released as an object.
b13.o1.refuerzo: Yes! A band releases an album with its songs.
b13.o2.refuerzo: A garage is a place, not something that is released.
b13.pregunta: What does a band release with its songs?
p.ensayan.consejo: From «ensayar», to practise before a show.
p.garaje.consejo: Where cars are kept, or where a band plays.
p.compone.consejo: From «componer», to write music or put together.
p.sacaron.consejo: From «sacar», to bring out. Here, to release an album.
p.foco.consejo: A lamp that lights one place strongly.
p.micrófonos.consejo: Used to capture the voice or instruments.
p.cuerdas.consejo: The thin lines that make sound on a guitar.
p.tensas.consejo: Not loose: the strings are pulled tight.
p.platillos.consejo: A metal part of a drum kit that you hit to make a crash sound.
p.viaja.consejo: From «viajar», to travel. The «v» is like «b», the «j» like «h».
p.practicar.consejo: Doing something again and again to get better.
p.actuar.consejo: Acting or playing in front of an audience.
